title: Hans Melo to Present at BPS 2024
summary: Menten AI's CEO, Dr. Hans Melo, will be sharing the latest developments at Menten AI in Boulder on adding drug-like properties including plasma stability and membrane-permeability.
body_markdown:
#### [Boulder Peptide Symposium 2024](https://www.boulderpeptide.org/)


##### **Peptide Showcase: Menten AI, Inc.**


Menten AI's CEO,[Dr. Hans Melo](https://www.linkedin.com/in/hansmelo/) , will be sharing the latest developments at[Menten AI](https://www.linkedin.com/company/menten-ai/) in Boulder on adding drug-like properties including plasma stability and membrane-permeability.
